meta.field_description: B2: B_z = B0 (1 + delta sin(k x - omega_w t)), weak spatiotemporal wave
meta.omega_c_ref_declaration: |q/m| |B(r_0, 0)|, declared in gt_common.py before any run
meta.omega_c_alt_declaration: time mean of |q/m||B| along the reference orbit; the declared sensitivity alternative, also scheme-independent
meta.phase_definition: atan2(|v x v_ref|, v . v_ref), radians
meta.corrector_checkpoint: boris_corrector_b4.pt -- ONE checkpoint; every corrector figure here is that single run, not an ensemble over seeds (W16)

trajectory.primary_is: rms over the record, Larmor radii

phase.primary_is: median over the second half, radians

energy.primary_is: median relative error over the second half

spectral.primary_is: PSD integral over nu < 0.2 Omega_c^ref, Hann; a POWER, so its G is twice the amplitude-equivalent G
